description: This PHP source file defines a class `Image_Graph_Layout_Matrix` that implements a layout for arranging graphical elements in a matrix/grid format. It includes methods for constructing the layout, managing entries, updating coordinates, and rendering the layout.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Layout_Matrix
classes.description: A class to arrange elements in a matrix layout within the graphics framework.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Layout_Matrix
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a matrix layout with given rows and columns, with optional auto-creation of plotareas.

methods.name: _pushEdges

methods.name: getEntry
methods.description: Retrieve the element at a specific row and column in the matrix.

methods.description: Set an element at a specific position in the matrix and update its edges.

methods.description: Update coordinates for all elements in the matrix layout.
